findings.reason: a control whose expected verdict is the same as a broken instrument's gives false assurance; the node needs a second fixture (a non-collapsed plan review) that the census must NOT report as pre-collapse-only.
findings.text: §2 declares its negative control to be "a review fixture built from a collapsed plan, which the census must count as pre-collapse-only"; that fixture is the input the census is *supposed* to count, so a census that mislabels every review as pre-collapse-only passes this control, and it cannot show the census discriminates

findings.reason: if the census counts form-membership as the uncovered set it can over-count the plans that owe a new review, and §3 would then gate the retirement on an inflated number the lead is asked to accept.
findings.text: §2 asserts "retiring it uncovers exactly those" reviews that match only through the pre-collapse form, but the cited reader joins a review to content by `record.get("plan_fingerprint") in _fingerprint_forms(...)` at `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:823-824` only for the whole-plan short-circuit; when that membership fails the code falls through to per-unit coverage, which recomputes each section's digest from the review's own snapshot (`record_digests` at `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:892-895`) and marks the review covered even though the retired form no longer matched

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited symbol resolves (`_fingerprint_forms`, `list_plan_reviews`, `delivered_reports`, `_delivered_report_sidecars` in `reckon/crew/plan_review.py`; `_apply_collapse_section` and the `collapse_section` op-table entry in `reckon/_store.py`; `declared_claim_paths` in `reckon/crew/claims.py`; `landed_section_ids` in `reckon/_plan_html.py`; the MCP op vocabulary in `reckon/mcp.py`; the landed-card reader in `reckon/mcp_views.py`), the cited informs-plan §7/§8 and decision `fingerprint-retirement-timing` exist, and the extensionless href `/reckon/plans/a-plan-is-done-when-every-section-is-ticked` resolves as `<path>.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §2's done-when names a control that cannot discriminate a census which reports every review as pre-collapse-only.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §2 writes its report under the run's own report directory (a durable path under `~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/`), not a scratchpad or node-local temp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags reach any symbol or filename; `§7`/`§8` are cross-plan section references in prose, which plans may carry.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §2's stated equivalence between "matches only through the pre-collapse form" and "uncovered on retirement" is not supported by the cited matching mechanism, which has a per-unit coverage path that survives the form's retirement.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §2 is one read-only census; §3 is one retirement (the form and the dead op that produced collapsed sections are the same mechanism), gated by §2.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the node table's `s3` depends-on `the-fingerprint-has-one-form#s2` resolves to a section that exists and gates the retirement, and `plan-informs a-plan-is-done-when-every-section-is-ticked` names the plan whose deferred §8 this work completes.
